buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) to be adhered to by the seller select ed through GeM bidding for providing housekeeping/sweeping/cleaning serv ices to the establishment of the District & Sessions Judge, Hojai : 1. 1. The contracted seller shall be responsible for maintaining cleanliness in all the Courts and Offices of the establishment of the District & Sessions Judge, Hojai and the residential quarter of the Hon’ble District & Sessions Judge, Hojai. 1. 2. The contracted seller shall be registered in the state of Assam and shall submit address of Head

Office and registration/trade license issued by the appropriate State Government authority along wi th domicile certificate of proprietor if requested by the Buyer. 1. 3. The broad scope of work shall include but not be limited to sweeping, dusting and moping of Cour t rooms, Officer’s chambers, Office rooms, Record Room (s), waiting areas, verandah, staircases, pa rking spaces, front yard, pathways, open spaces, polishing of floor tiles, emptying of waste bins, bur ning of garbage and trimming of grass. 1. 4. Cleaning of doors, windows, ventilators, aluminum window channels, partitions etc. should be car ried out as and when directed. 1. 5. Public and office lavatories/toilets/urinals/washrooms should be cleaned using disinfectants and o ther cleaning agents. Sanitary fittings, bathroom floor and wall tiles, mirrors etc, should also be clea ned on a daily basis and as and when required. 1. 6. Unclogging of toilets, wash basins, outlet pipes/meshes etc. should be carried out on a regular ba sis and as and when required. Filing of toilets/washrooms etc. with hand wash, naphthalene balls an d air freshener should be carried out on a regular basis and as and when required. 1. 7. The contracted seller shall not be responsible for supply of cleaning consumables. 1. 8. It shall be the responsibility of the contracted seller to ensure the regular attendance/presence of 2 (two) nos. of housekeeping & sweeping staff notwithstanding leave availed, migration, desertion e tc. by the manpower engaged by the seller. If any housekeeping staff remains absent without imme diate replacement, the proportionate wage shall be deducted from the bill due to the contracted sell er. 1. 9. The staff engaged shall be required to be present on the Court premises at 8: 00 a.m. on all work ing days and execute the tasks assigned to them and remain on duty until 4: 00 p.m. 1. 10. The housekeeping staff provided by the contracted seller shall maintain proper decorum inside and outside the Judicial Court premise and shall be courteous in their behavior with the Officers, staf f and Advocates in the Court premise. 1. 11. The contracted seller shall be held responsible for any damage of infrastructure or Court equip ment, theft of Court property or personal belongings of Officers or staff members or any other dama ge caused by unruly or mischievous conduct on part of the housekeeping staff engaged by the selle r. 1. 12. The contracted seller shall be responsible for safety and security of the housekeeping staff enga ged by them. The establishment of the District & Sessions Judge, Hojai shall not be responsible for a ny monetary claim made by the housekeeping staff engaged by the seller or any benefit due to the m. 1. 13. The contracted seller shall furnish to the details of the housekeeping staff engaged by them, to the undersigned and provide updated details, as and when required.

1. 14. The contracted seller shall submit the bills to the establishment on a monthly basis. 1. 15. The Buyer shall clear the bill amount either on a monthly basis or the accumulated due of multip le months subject to availability of budget and other administrative contingency. 1. 16. There shall be no gap in the contracted service period. The seller shall be liable to continue the service without any interruption and shall not withheld the same on any delay in payment of the mo nthly bill amount owing to non-availability of budget or any other administrative contingency. 1. 17. The contracted seller shall submit the detailed breakdown of the cost incurred as and when requ ested by the Buyer. 1. 18. The rates submitted in the bid shall be inclusive of GST. Tax Deduction shall be made at the app licable rate as per rules. 1. 19. The contracted seller shall ensure that the engagement of the housekeeping & sweeping staff is voluntary in nature and as per relevant rules and labor laws. 1. 20. The housekeeping staff may be required to take up additional cleaning duties, not beyond the s cope of their core competency, on occasions or as directed by the establishment on a contingency b asis. .
